name: 資訊食客
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished logo concept for "infovore", a personal lifelog aggregating games, movies, anime, books, music and life activities into a durable timeline. Flat vector-friendly graphic design, original memorable silhouette, professional restrained playful identity, bold simple geometry legible as a favicon. Square presentation on solid near-white background, generous whitespace. One large symbol centered above the exact lowercase wordmark "infovore" in carefully spaced contemporary sans serif. No other text, no mockups, no gradients, no shadows, no textures, no fine details. Palette derived from project's dark UI: deep charcoal #111317 and lavender #a9b0ff, use darker violet where needed for white-background contrast. A distinctive abstract information-eating creature: a chunky asymmetric open loop with an angular inward mouth notch, receiving two small rounded square information morsels. Sophisticated logo rather than cartoon. Avoid resemblance to Pac-Man: no circular disc, no triangular wedge, no eyes. Express appetite for media using a compact folded ribbon-like silhouette.
